misc.text: #ONEPIECE1190 The crazy thing, even beyond Gaban's lightning-bolt Haki, is the fact that Imu, possessing the strongest CoC of all (after Joyboy), could easily unleash something similar (but on a completely different level). Don't you realize? So far, Imu has only fought using the legendary weapons; he has barely used his Haki at all. He is still playing with his food, barely use his df skills... If Imu unleash his haki lvl, we gonna have a new different topic. He is truly the current strongest monster in One Piece...
